fences.rule: What exercise consumes on the holder's own side is here; a power spent by disuse is power-trades' Leased strike, and what a power fetches when passed to another hand is power-trades' throughout.
fences.case: A strike threat the employer no longer believes because the union has not struck in twenty years.

fences.rule: The fence is direction: an advantage that exercise consumes is in, an advantage that exercise builds and disuse consumes is walkaway-manufactures' Walk on record.
fences.case: A retailer whose past walk from a national brand makes its next threat to walk credible.

fences.rule: Standing converted into another form at a rate, or sold for money, is status-conversions'; standing consumed as a side effect of an exercise that was neither a conversion nor a sale is here.
fences.case: status-conversions' Introducer's tab, where each introduction is billed to the introducer at a rate rather than the first costing almost everything.

fences.rule: From risk-rebound-effects' seat the antibiotic is a mitigation breeding its resistant successor; from this seat it is a condition shared across every holder and spent by selection on the pathogen's clock, so what changes across is whether the successor risk or the shape of the spend is read.
fences.case: An antibiotic that leaves the survivors, so that one holder's restraint preserves nothing while other holders dose.

fences.rule: Tier above's mark, the count of tiers, records how many times the rare signal has been spent, and reading that count as elapsed spending is an instance of clocks-that-are-not-clocks' Ratchet count.
fences.case: The escalation from priority to urgent to critical read like tree rings for how many times the flag was used.

fences.rule: A concession that reveals a need and manufactures the other side's alternative is deal-deaths' Concession-made option; a grant that reveals nothing and binds only by being cited back and repeated is Exception cited back here.
fences.case: An end-of-quarter discount granted once that the next petitioner cites as precedent.
